loop: Check a habit off today, keep the streak alive, watch it grow.
data: Habit (name, icon, schedule, target, current streak, best streak), Check-in (habit, date, done)
pitfalls: The streak is the emotional centre of this app: show it large, not as a number in a row
Checking a habit off is the one action the app exists for — make it the biggest, easiest target on the screen
A day missed is not a failure state: show the streak that survived, never a red warning
